fieldValues.title: meta still drops silently on three WASM/transition record-create paths
fieldValues.summary: srs-rust#1031 fixed meta round-tripping for the three input structs the issue named (CreateRecordInput, UpdateRecordInput, CreateRecordSuccessorInput), reachable from CLI record create/update/successor, MCP, and the WASM update_record/create_record_successor bindings. Three sibling write paths share the identical root cause but were deliberately left untouched because the issue did not name them.
evidence: crates/srs-bindings/src/lib.rs create_record (WASM) and create_record_in_container (WASM) deserialize into a separate CreateRecordBindingInput{field_values, field_meta, tags} shadow struct that never reaches CreateRecordInput at all, so adding extra to CreateRecordInput did not fix these two.

crates/srs-repository/src/record_store.rs FulfillmentNewRecord{field_values, type_version} (used by transition_record_lifecycle's fulfillment.newRecord path) has no field_meta or extra field either; its create_record_at_dir call passes field_meta: None and gets an empty extra with no way for the caller to set either.
record_store::CreateRecordInContainerInput (also WASM-only, no CLI caller found by grep) mirrors CreateRecordInput's pre-fix shape one field short and was left as-is.
fieldValues.body: Not fixed in PR https://github.com/the-greenman/srs-rust/pull/1034 on purpose: the issue's audit list named record create, record update, note create/update, and record successor specifically, and note create/update turned out to already be correct (Note carries a named meta field). Widening the PR to also rewire the WASM-only create_record/create_record_in_container bindings and the lifecycle-transition fulfillment.newRecord path would have doubled the diff for call sites nobody reported a defect against. If a caller needs meta on record create through the WASM binding (not create_record_in_context, which CLI uses and which IS fixed) or through a fulfillment-triggered successor, file a follow-up issue naming these three call sites rather than rediscovering them by re-reading record_store.rs and lib.rs from scratch.
